newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish WIG index seen at 15,918 at end-July - poll.
newsitem.headline: Polish WIG index seen at 15,918 at end-July - poll.

text.p: Polish brokerages see the Warsaw bourse's main WIG index rising to 15,918 points at the end of July, a monthly poll by financial daily Dziennik Prawa i Gospodarki showed.
The poll said the WIG would reach 17,990 points at year-end and 18,843 points at the end of June next year.
About a month ago the brokerages had seen the WIG index at 16,966 points at year-end and 19,620 at the end of June 1998.
The WIG index closed at 15,572.8 points on Friday.
